// diagnostic

E2110

Automatic memory management failed, or its trace cannot be reported.

What

Automatic memory management failed, or its trace cannot be reported.

Why

The private collector rejected an unsafe or impossible operation, or the trace is missing, unsafe to read, larger than 4 MiB, malformed, incompatible, stale, or incomplete. Reports never estimate promotions omitted by a bounded trace.

Fix

check the trace path and retry with a smaller workload; for reports, run `jet run --gc-trace <file.jet>` before `jet gc report`. Exits 1 (user error).
